definition_zh: adj. 强调的；断然的；语气强的；（结果）压倒性的
definition_en: said or done with force and clear determination, leaving no doubt
core_image: 谈判桌上，代表把文件推到中间，一根手指压在最后一行上，抬眼扫过对面所有人
scene: 代表把文件推到桌子中间，一根手指压在最后一行上。 Her refusal was emphatic and left no room for argument.
sceneCN: 这里 emphatic 指「断然的」（第 2 个义项：毫不含糊、不容置疑）；句意是她的拒绝斩钉截铁，没有争辩余地。

pos.zh: 强调的；断然的；语气强的

senses.title: Said with force
senses.definition: expressed with special force so that it cannot be missed
senses.definitionCN: （形容词）以特别有力的方式表达，让人无法忽略
senses.example: He gave an emphatic nod that settled the whole discussion.
senses.exampleCN: 他用力点了一下头，整场讨论就此定了下来。
senses.why: A finger pressed on the last line of a paper pushed to the middle of a table
senses.whyCN: 一根手指压在推到桌子中间的文件最后一行上

senses.title: Leaving no doubt
senses.definition: firm and clear, allowing no argument or uncertainty
senses.definitionCN: （形容词）坚定明确，不容争辩或怀疑
senses.example: The answer was an emphatic no.
senses.exampleCN: 回答是一个斩钉截铁的「不」。
senses.why: A door closed once and the key turned twice in the lock
senses.whyCN: 门关上一回，钥匙在锁里转了两圈

senses.title: Decisive in result
senses.definition: very clear and decisive in outcome
senses.definitionCN: （形容词）结果非常明确、具有决定性
senses.example: The team won an emphatic victory by five goals.
senses.exampleCN: 球队以五球之差取得一场压倒性胜利。
senses.why: A scoreboard whose two columns are too far apart to argue about
senses.whyCN: 记分牌上两栏数字差得让人无从争辩

intro.en: Emphatic comes from Greek emphasis, a showing forth, built on phainein, to show; what is shown plainly cannot be overlooked.
intro.cn: emphatic 来自希腊语 emphasis（显示），建立在 phainein（显示）之上；被明白显示出来的东西无法被忽视。

items.en: Phainein means to show or to bring to light, and gives phenomenon and phantom.
items.cn: phainein 意为显示、使显现，给出 phenomenon 与 phantom。

items.en: Emphasis means a showing forth or an appearance, from en- plus phainein.
items.cn: emphasis 意为显示、显现，由 en- 加 phainein 构成。

items.en: Emphatikos means expressive or significant, the adjective of emphasis.
items.cn: emphatikos 意为有表现力的、意味深长的，是 emphasis 的形容词。

items.en: Latin carries emphaticus into the rhetoric of the schools.
items.cn: 拉丁语把 emphaticus 带进经院修辞学。

items.en: English uses emphatic of stress in speech and of firm manner.
items.cn: 英语用 emphatic 指说话的重音与坚决的态度。

items.en: Sport and reporting extend emphatic to decisive results.
items.cn: 体育与报道把 emphatic 扩展到决定性的结果。

note.en: Emphatic, emphasis and emphasize all come from Greek phainein, to show; pathetic and sympathetic come from pathos, feeling, and are unrelated.
note.cn: emphatic、emphasis 与 emphasize 都来自希腊语 phainein（显示）；pathetic 与 sympathetic 来自 pathos（感受），彼此无关。

entries.definition: expressed with strength and conviction
entries.definitionCN: 有力的；坚定的

entries.definition: settling an issue clearly and finally
entries.definitionCN: 决定性的；果断的

dict_mnemonic.text: emphatic ＝ em-（在内）＋ phat（显示，希腊 phainein）＋ -ic（形容词后缀）＝「把意思显示出来的」→ 强调的、断然的。名词 emphasis 强调、重点，动词 emphasize 强调，副词 emphatically 断然地、强调地，反义 unemphatic 平淡的。三类用法：语气 an emphatic refusal 断然拒绝、an emphatic denial 坚决否认、in emphatic terms 用强硬措辞；态度 emphatic about the deadline 对截止日期毫不含糊；结果 an emphatic victory 压倒性胜利、an emphatic win 大胜。比较级 more emphatic。注意与 empathetic（有共情力的）拼写相近但词根完全不同：emphatic 是 phainein 显示，empathetic 是 pathos 感受。重音落在第二音节上。

root: 希腊语 en-（在内）＋ phainein（显示）→ emphasis（显示）→ emphatikos（有表现力的）→ emphatic（强调的）

latinEntries.meaningCN: 有表现力的；意味深长的

definition_zh: 试音；试演；面试（表演类）；（列）听觉
definition_en: a short performance given to test whether a performer is suitable for a role; also, the sense of hearing
core_image: 把一段表演摆在考官耳朵前接受检验
scene: 后台走廊里，女孩反复默念台词，心跳如鼓。 She waited outside the room for her first audition.
sceneCN: 这里 audition 指「试演、试镜」（第 1 个义项：求职性质的表演测试）；句意：她在门外等待自己人生第一次试镜。

pos.zh: 试音；试演；对……进行试演测试

derivatives.zh: 参加试演的人（audition + -ee 受动者后缀）
听觉的（同族词，出自 audit-）
试镜通知；选角公告（复合词）

senses.title: A test performance for a role
senses.definition: a short trial performance to judge a performer's suitability for a part
senses.definitionCN: 为判断表演者是否胜任某角色而进行的简短测试表演
senses.example: She got the lead role after a single audition.
senses.exampleCN: 仅一次试演后她就拿到了主角。
senses.why: The root is hearing: the judges decide with their ears, so the trial is named after listening.
senses.whyCN: 词根是「听」：考官用耳朵裁决，这场测试便以「听」命名。

senses.title: To take part in such a test
senses.definition: to perform at an audition in the hope of being chosen
senses.definitionCN: 参加试演，以求被选中
senses.example: Three hundred dancers auditioned for the show.
senses.exampleCN: 三百名舞者为这档节目参加了试演。
senses.why: The noun slid into a verb without effort, as English names do.
senses.whyCN: 名词毫不费力地转为动词，这是英语命名的一贯做法。

senses.title: To test someone by a trial performance
senses.definition: to ask a performer to give a trial performance in order to judge them
senses.definitionCN: 请表演者进行测试表演以便评估
senses.example: The director auditioned over a hundred children for the film.
senses.exampleCN: 导演为这部电影试演了一百多名孩子。
senses.why: The verb faces both ways: the performer auditions, and the director auditions them.
senses.whyCN: 这个动词可双向使用：表演者参加试演，导演也「试演」表演者。

senses.title: The sense of hearing
senses.definition: the sense or power of hearing, especially in scientific use
senses.definitionCN: 听觉能力，多用于科学语境
senses.example: Bats rely on audition to navigate in the dark.
senses.exampleCN: 蝙蝠依靠听觉在黑暗中导航。
senses.why: The Latin audire gives hearing a formal noun; science revived this older sense.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 audire 为听觉提供了正式名词；科学界重新启用了这一旧义。

senses.title: A trial of anything by listening
senses.definition: a trial of a musician, instrument, or recording by listening to it
senses.definitionCN: 通过试听来检验乐手、乐器或录音
senses.example: The orchestra held auditions for a new first violin.
senses.exampleCN: 乐团为新任首席小提琴举办试奏。
senses.why: Musicians audition with sound alone, so the listening root fits them most literally.
senses.whyCN: 乐手单凭声音应试，「听」的词根在他们身上最为贴切。

senses.title: A formal hearing or interview
senses.definition: in older use, a formal interview or opportunity to be heard by someone important
senses.definitionCN: 旧义：正式接见，或在要人面前陈情的机会
senses.example: The ambassador was granted an audition with the queen.
senses.exampleCN: 大使获女王正式接见。
senses.why: Before casting calls, an audition meant simply a hearing before power.
senses.whyCN: 在试镜出现之前，audition 就是「在权贵面前得闻」之意。

senses.title: A tryout in extended use
senses.definition: any test that decides whether someone or something qualifies
senses.definitionCN: 决定某人或某物是否合格的任何考验
senses.example: Every crisis is an audition for leadership.
senses.exampleCN: 每场危机都是对领导力的检验。
senses.why: The judged-performance idea spread from stage to life, where leaders too perform for judges.
senses.whyCN: 「被审视的表演」这一概念从舞台延伸到人生——领导者同样要在评审面前表演。

senses.title: In audiology and animal studies
senses.definition: hearing as studied in audiology and animal behavior
senses.definitionCN: 听力科学与动物行为学所研究的听觉
senses.example: The study measured audition in older adults.
senses.exampleCN: 该研究测量了老年人的听觉。
senses.why: Technical writing prefers audition when it wants a precise, neutral noun for hearing.
senses.whyCN: 当技术文献需要一个精确中立的听觉名词时，便会选用 audition。

intro.en: Audition comes from Latin auditio, a hearing, formed on audire, to hear; English first used it for the sense of hearing and for a formal hearing, and only in the late nineteenth century for a test performance.
intro.cn: audition 出自拉丁语 auditio「听」，基础为动词 audire「听」；英语最初用它指听觉与正式接见，19 世纪末才转指测试表演。

items.en: The root *h₂ewis- meant to perceive, to hear, the shared source of the Latin hearing family.
items.cn: 词根 *h₂ewis- 意为「感知、听见」，是拉丁语「听」词族的共同源头。

items.en: audire meant to hear; its participle stem audit- supplied auditio, a hearing or listening.
items.cn: 拉丁语 audire 意为「听」；其分词词干 audit- 构成 auditio，意为「听；倾听」。

items.en: auditio named both the act of hearing and, in rhetoric, a case argued before a judge.
items.cn: auditio 既指「听」这一行为，在修辞学中也指在裁判前申辩的案件。

items.en: audition entered English meaning the sense of hearing and, by extension, a formal hearing before a great person.
items.cn: audition 进入英语时指听觉，引申为在显贵面前的正式接见。

items.en: The theatrical sense arose in the late nineteenth century: a trial performance is a hearing for the ears of the judges.
items.cn: 戏剧义产生于 19 世纪末：测试表演就是一场呈于考官耳中的「听审」。

items.en: Today the theatrical verb and noun dominate, while science keeps the older hearing sense in audition and audiology.
items.cn: 如今戏剧义的动名词占主导，而科学界仍在 audition 与 audiology 中保留古老的听觉义。

note.en: Group one collects the hearing family and aud- look-alikes; group two collects neighboring tryout and hearing words.
note.cn: 第一组收「听」词族及 aud- 形近词；第二组收相邻的「测试」与「听觉」词。

entries.definition: relating to hearing; the adjective sibling of audition's hearing sense.
entries.definitionCN: 听觉的；audition 听觉义的形容词同胞词。

entries.definitionCN: 审计员；历史上指「听者」。同根异流。

entries.definition: bold, from audare, to dare; shares only the aud- spelling.
entries.definitionCN: 大胆的，出自「敢」的词根；仅拼写同以 aud- 开头。

entries.definition: a printed version, from Latin editio, a giving out; one letter apart, unrelated root.
entries.definitionCN: 版本，出自拉丁语 editio「刊行」；仅差一个字母，词根无关。

entries.definition: an informal audition or trial, common in sports.
entries.definitionCN: 非正式的试演或选拔，体育中常用。

entries.definition: a formal meeting to judge suitability, for jobs rather than roles.
entries.definitionCN: 面试；用于求职而非选角。

entries.definition: a public announcement inviting people to audition.
entries.definitionCN: 选角公告；邀请人们来试镜。

entries.definition: the everyday word for the sense that audition names formally.
entries.definitionCN: 听觉的日常说法；audition 是其正式对应。

entries.definition: a filmed audition for film or television.
entries.definitionCN: 为影视拍摄的试镜录像。

normalIntro.en: audition is a hearing: audi for listen, -tion for the act, first of ears, then of judges.
normalIntro.cn: audition 就是一场「听审」：audi 表「听」，-tion 表行为——先属于耳朵，后属于考官。

normal.en: audi + tion: the act of hearing, exactly like edition is the act of giving out.
normal.cn: audi + tion：听的行为，正如 edition 是刊行的行为。

normal.en: An audition is literally a hearing before the people who decide.
normal.cn: 试演的字面义就是在裁决者面前「受审听」。

normal.en: The family: audible, audience, auditorium, audition, auditory.
normal.cn: 同族词：audible、audience、auditorium、audition、auditory。

normal.en: audition for a role is the set verb pattern to memorize.
normal.cn: audition for a role 是值得记牢的动词搭配。

normal.en: In science, audition just means hearing, no stage required.
normal.cn: 在科学语境里，audition 就指听觉，与舞台无关。

abstract.en: Picture one chair, one spotlight, and three silent ears behind a table.
abstract.cn: 想象一把椅子、一束追光，和桌后三只沉默的耳朵。

abstract.en: The word holds its breath before the first note.
abstract.cn: 这个词在第一个音符前屏住呼吸。

abstract.en: Audition is a door that opens only for a performed minute.
abstract.cn: audition 是一扇只为一段表演敞开一分钟的门。

examples.en: He practiced the monologue for weeks before the audition.
examples.cn: 试演前他花了数周练习那段独白。

examples.en: Over a thousand singers auditioned for the talent show.
examples.cn: 上千名歌手报名参加了选秀节目的试音。

examples.en: Age slowly dulls the sense of audition.
examples.cn: 听觉会随年龄增长而逐渐迟钝。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses trace one noun from ears to stage: hearing itself, a formal hearing, and the judged performance the theater made of it.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项追溯一个名词从耳朵走向舞台的轨迹：听觉本身、正式接见，以及戏剧界由此造出的测试表演。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a performed minute laid before judging ears.
core.cn: 核心意象：一段表演被呈递到裁决的耳朵面前。

branches.en: THE STAGE SIDE: trial performances for actors and musicians.
branches.cn: 舞台一面：演员与乐手的测试表演。

branches.en: THE VERB SIDE: to audition and to audition someone.
branches.cn: 动词一面：参加试演与试演某人。

branches.en: THE SCIENCE SIDE: hearing as a measured sense.
branches.cn: 科学一面：作为可测官能的听觉。

branches.en: THE OLD SIDE: a formal hearing before power.
branches.cn: 旧义一面：在权势面前的正式接见。

branches.en: THE EXTENDED SIDE: life's crises as auditions for character.
branches.cn: 引申一面：人生的危机成为品格的试演。

intro.en: audition is the stem audit- plus -ion, the Latin way to name an act; the same stem powers auditory and auditor.
intro.cn: audition 由词干 audit- 加 -ion 构成，这是拉丁语为「行为」命名的方式；同一词干也支撑着 auditory 与 auditor。

latinIntro.en: Latin audire, to hear, anchors the family: audible, audience, audio, auditory, auditorium, audition.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 audire「听」统率词族：audible、audience、audio、auditory、auditorium、audition。
